faq_heading: Coquitlam condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Coquitlam condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 197 of 849, or 23%. A further 512 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in Coquitlam?
faq.a: $610,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is below the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $505,000 and $699,900.

faq.q: Which Coquitlam area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: Central Coquitlam, at $426,250 across 26 sales at $516 a square foot, median year built 1982. The highest of the 8 lowest was New Horizons at $695,000.

faq.q: How fast do Coquitlam condos sell?
faq.a: 24 days at the median, closing at 97.4% of the last list price, with 6% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $600,000).

In Coquitlam, 197 of the 849 condos (23%) sold under $600,000. The median was $610,000, with the middle half between $505,000 and $699,900. The busiest price range, $600,000 to $799,999, had 512 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in Coquitlam

In Central Coquitlam the median condo sold for $426,250 across 26 sales, $173,750 under $600,000. Across Coquitlam the median condo took 24 days to sell and closed at 97.4% of the last list price, with 6% of the 849 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
